title: Retractions and pointwise stabilizing selectors for countable closed profinite covers
statement:
Let $S$ be a nonempty compact metrizable Hausdorff totally disconnected space with a fixed compatible metric. Let $(A_j)_{j\geq1}$ be nonempty closed subsets with $S=\bigcup_{j\geq1}A_j$. In the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], there exist refining finite clopen partitions $\mathcal P_i$ of $S$, $i\geq1$, whose nonempty atoms have diameter $<2^{-i}$, and continuous maps $\rho_j:S\to A_j$ with $\rho_j(a)=a$ for every $a\in A_j$. Give each finite set $\mathcal P_i$ the discrete topology. The atom map
$$e:S\longrightarrow\prod_{i\geq1}\mathcal P_i,\qquad e(s)_i=\text{the atom containing }s,$$
is a homeomorphism onto its image, and each $e(A_j)$ is nonempty and closed in that product. With
$$U_{j,i}=\bigcup\{P\in\mathcal P_i:P\cap A_j\ne\varnothing\},$$
the sets $U_{j,i}$ are clopen, decrease as $i$ increases, and satisfy $\bigcap_iU_{j,i}=A_j$. Define $k_i:S\to\{1,\ldots,i\}$ as the least $j\leq i$ with $s\in U_{j,i}$, and as $1$ if there is no such $j$. Each $k_i$ is locally constant. For every $s\in S$, writing $j(s)=\min\{j\geq1:s\in A_j\}$, there exists $i_0(s)$ such that $k_i(s)=j(s)$ for every $i\geq i_0(s)$. No uniform stabilization in $s$, disjointness, or openness of the $A_j$ is assumed.

Step 8: a finite maximum gives pointwise stabilization. Edge cases checked: singleton S, A_j = S, j(s) = 1, a non-uniform cover of {0} together with {1/n}, and overlapping A_j.
